notes.title: 1.1.0 - Desert Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/078d7fad696d2670e297f88adf28369da650fb6b.jpg[/img]
[[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2861120097]Hover car[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2861164005]Sky crane[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2857642012]Humvee[/url]]
[h1]Hello engineers![/h1]
Almost a month has passed since the release - it's time to release a major update. A big part of this update is technical improvements to the game: the system for saving nodes has been completely rewritten, which will allow us to localize them and protect them from problems in the future.

[h2]Main innovation[/h2]
The main innovation is the desert map. The main difference of which is that it has a relief, while it is endless. Also in its sands lives something that will impatiently destroy your building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/70a13270cc085a83ca749b17b9d246d2c6657126.jpg[/img]

[h2]Redesigned ports[/h2]
All ports in the game have been reworked, which may require you to rearrange them in your buildings in order for them to work correctly. [b]Ports now have:[/b]
[list]
[*] built-in magnets for easy docking
[*] indicator lights to indicate when a connection is established between ports
[*] boolean output indicating when another port is connected
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bsVLoKq.gif[/img]

[h2]Visual layers[/h2]
The ability to customize the display layer of an object in a building has been added, now you can bring beauty to your building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/6f7709c79096d77d3861176f040fe04311b04da5.png[/img]
[[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2864195635]Rally buggy[/url]]

[h2]Wikipedia[/h2]
Thanks to the initiative of the players, PixPhys has an official [b][url=https://pixphys.fandom.com/wiki/PixPhys_Wiki]Wikipedia on Fandom[/url][/b].
[i]Thanks to the players [b]Laska[/b] and [b]Sovmeshchenets[/b].[/i]

[h3][b]Added:[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Electricity update (0.8)
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LRg0GxZ.gif[/img]
[h1]Hi engineers![/h1]

A month has passed since the last update, which means it's time for a new update! This update brings a ton of content to the game. The main innovation in this update is the addition of electricity.

[h1]Electricity.[/h1]

As mentioned earlier, this part of the update is the main one. Therefore, most of the new content belongs to it. A significant number of appliances in the game now require electricity to operate. It is logical that in order to use electricity, it must be obtained somehow, for this there are such items as a Generator, a Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generator, and a Solar Panel. Also, electrical connections are not built in the same way as logical ones - they do not have inputs and outputs, they are all something in between.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/58dd054815b99a48a2ec12fac11c69fe6cf30fe0.png[/img]

[h1]Icon caching.[/h1]

In this update, icon caching was added, which means that loading when entering the game will be reduced or completely lost. Now it will only happen once per game update. All icons will be stored in the following path:

[i]C: /Users/ [b]YourUsername[/b] /AppData/LocalLow/RedStarhip/PixPhys/Thumbnails[/i]

[h1]New interface.[/h1]

In this update, almost the entire game interface has been changed, except for the menu. Added slots for easier construction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/20793ce4b12d07217a64a80dd8912dee78446a4d.png[/img]

[h1]New music.[/h1]

Now PixPhys has completely new music from another composer, as well as ambient for being near the surface and in space.

[previewyoutube=z5l11hO4mUQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Change settings.[/h1]

Now you can disable in the settings: at home in the background on the flat card, post processing, output of system messages to the console, adjust the volume of the music.

[h1]Multiplayer.[/h1]

Work has begun on multiplayer. At the moment, it works very badly and therefore ordinary players cannot enter it now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/f4f55f7152d92832347a601b614e73c51d5e22e3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Tools update (0.6)
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vyxLPGm.gif[/img]
[h1]Good day, Engineers![/h1]
The second update for our young game is coming out today. It comes out 2 to 3 weeks after the release.
This update brings new tools, items, achievements to the game, bugs fixed.

[h2]Robot.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/5f46a6a7ba34ac77e3842b58cf599cea5db574ac.png[/img]
One of the interesting innovations is the robot. With it, you can revive Charles, or you can make a robo-landing.

[h2]Localization.[/h2]
Work has begun on a localization system. It was created to support other languages ​​by the game (not officially). After finalizing this system, the Workshop will be able to publish and download your localization options.

[h2]Workshop.[/h2]
In this update, Steam Workshop was affected. We've changed the save tags, and now it's easier to find buildings that fit your needs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/d921154874ee23197f3efd002bf86eca4935feee.png[/img]

Also, for this function, the procedure for publishing saves to the workshop has been updated and a corresponding window has been added.

[h2]Bearings.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/369754736949cff9359cc9d05921c70d1c8186cf.png[/img]
This update introduces bearings with which you can create movable joints and pneumatic mechanisms, like this landing gear.

[h2]Mod cache.[/h2]
The game now has a system for caching mod files. For example, this is needed if you have a music player and you load several audio files into it when you spawn. The computer will take time to do this, and in order not to repeat this operation, the game will save the data about the file to memory.

[h2]Achievements.[/h2]
2 new achievements have been added.
1 - Take Charles to space without touching.
2 - Create 1000 logical links.

[h2]Mechanisms.[/h2]
Button press mode - requires pressing the button.
Logic gate - does not pass the signal if there is no signal at the middle input.
CMG - use it to spin your building around it.
Advanced speedometer mode - allows you to get speed along different axes.
Impact detector - in a collision, returns the force of the collision.

notes.title: Alpha release
notes.notes:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]
We think you're got tired waiting this moment, and finally your wait comes to an end!
Yes! We release our creation on a free voyage (almost)
Yes, that is not full release of the game, but this is steam release. That moment, when our approach to the game must be serious.
Besides release, we have few other news.
[h1]0.4 and 0.5 changelog[/h1]
[h2]0.4[/h2]
[h3]Added:[/h3]
-Matress
-Vector2
-Vector2 converter
-Warp drive
-Light bulb
-Steam workshop
[h3]Fixed/changed:[/h3]
-Bugfixes
-Complete texture rework
-Small ModAPI rework
[h2]0.5[/h2]
[h3]Added:[/h3]
-Nuke
-Clocks
-New map (Planet)
-Sounds for piston
-Saves support for workshop
[h3]Fixed/changed:[/h3]
-Bugfixes
h3 Deleted:
-Lamp
[h1]Warp Drive[/h1]
Like it was said in changelog, we added warp drive. What is warp drive? In our game this is device with which you can "teleport" in any point of space-time. It has 3 inputs and 1 output. Output is progress of warp drive's charging. Two inputs that have red color are charging switch and functioning switch. Third input is coordinates.
[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
In conclusion, we want to say that one of the most difficult things we have already gone through. Enjoy the update and wait for the news!
